messages:
maria: PTAL — addressed the comments on PR #3421 (split config into cfg package + small refactor). I ran unit tests locally and updated the changelog. Pushed a new commit: 7f9a3b. Ran smoke script: `./scripts/smoke.sh --pr 3421` (passed). Can I get one more set of eyes before I schedule canary? :pray:

alex: Looking now. Two tiny nits: rename cfg.Load -> cfg.LoadConfig and add a short comment on the exported func. Otherwise LGTM.

maria: cool, doing that now. will push in ~10m.

shaun: pinging re: canary window — is today okay? we have a free slot at 16:00 PT.

maria: 16:00 PT works for me. I won't be available exactly at 16:00 but can monitor and be reachable via phone. @luis can you own the merge ops if things look green?

luis: I can handle merge + canary ops. Quick question — do we need to add a rollback tag?

maria: added rollback note in the PR description and a canary healthcheck in the smoke script. Example check: `curl -sS http://canary.local/health | grep ok`

alex: pushed a tiny commit suggestion in the PR branch -> fixed the func name and comment. PTAL again when you can.

maria: saw it, applied and force-pushed. New commit 2b4c1e. thanks!

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: PR 3421 -> canary-2024-06-09-16:00 (slot reserved by luis).

shaun: perfect. luis, please abort if latency jumps >50% in the first 10 minutes, and roll back if error rate >1%.

luis: noted. I'll run the smoke & perf checks and report back here.

maria: thanks all. PTAL -> if no objections I'll request merge ops 15m before the slot.

alex: LGTM now. :thumbsup:

shaun: no objections from me.

luis: ready to merge on my side. send merge-ops request.
